name: flaht bladi — verified Tadla map places v1

metadata.purpose: P0 map points for the M3 'Interactive Tadla mapping' milestone (cahier des charges v1.1, FR-E01..E05). Verified geometry only; no zone polygons (FR-E02/E08) and no provisional points (documentation strategy: no placeholders that look real).
known_gaps: Irrigation-sector polygons excluded: no official ORMVAT GIS boundary obtained yet (request pending via Local Lead).
Beni Moussa / Beni Amir zone label points excluded from this verified layer: their centers are team-derived approximations, not sourced geometry.
Wholesale markets and seed suppliers: no verified coordinates collected yet — the frontend should show honest empty categories.

Dam capacities reported by sources differ (Bin El Ouidane: ~1,215.5 to 1,500 million m3; Ahmed El Hansali: 668.2 to 740 million m3) — values intentionally omitted from this layer until ABHOER/ORMVAT confirms.
metadata.provenance_rule: Every feature carries its source, verification date and precision caveat. Do not edit values without team review; update docs/decisions.md in the same PR if a source is upgraded.

properties.detail_en: Rock-fill dam on Oued El Abid, commissioned 1953; serves the Beni Moussa irrigation perimeter (and the Tassaout perimeter).
properties.detail_ar: سد على واد العبيد، أنجز سنة 1953؛ يغذي محيط بني موسى السقوي.
source: Coordinates: Wikipedia 'Bin el Ouidane Dam' (secondary source)
Role and commissioning year: ORMVAT Monographie, https://ormvatadla.ma/monographie/ (institutional)
properties.precision_caveat: Coordinates from a secondary source; confirm with ABHOER/ORMVAT before public production use.

properties.detail_en: Concrete-faced rock-fill dam on the Oum Er-Rbia (height 101 m), commissioned 2001; serves the Beni Amir irrigation perimeter.
properties.detail_ar: سد على أودية أم الربيع، أنجز سنة 2001؛ يغذي محيط بني عامر السقوي.
source: Site description corroborated by Global Energy Monitor (Ait Oum El Bekht, cercle de El Ksiba) and press describing the dam near Zaouiat Cheikh on the Khénifra road
Role and commissioning year: ORMVAT Monographie, https://ormvatadla.ma/monographie/ (institutional)
properties.precision_caveat: Coordinates from a secondary source (corroborated by two independent site descriptions); confirm with ABHOER before public production use.

properties.detail_en: Capital of the Béni Mellal-Khénifra region.
source: Coordinates: HCP Annuaire statistique régional (official, published as 32°22' N / 6°24' W)
properties.precision_caveat: Official publication gives degrees-minutes precision (~1.8 km).

properties.detail_en: Historic town of the Tadla plain; hosts the SUTA sugar refinery (Cosumar group).
properties.detail_ar: مدينة تاريخية في سهل تادلة؛ تحتضن مصنع السكر SUTA.
source: Coordinates: geographical coordinate databases, 32.595828 / -6.269461 (secondary source, two consistent records)
SUTA refinery: ORMVAT Monographie industrial table (institutional)

properties.detail_en: Seat of the ORMVAT (Regional Agricultural Development Office of Tadla).
properties.detail_ar: مقر المكتب الجهوي للتنمية الفلاحية لتادلة (ORMVAT).
source: Coordinates: geographical coordinate databases, 32.50444 / -6.68639 (secondary source, two consistent records)
ORMVAT seat: author affiliation in Hammani et al. (IAV/Cirad/ORMVAT), https://core.ac.uk/download/52632235.pdf
properties.precision_caveat: Coordinates from secondary sources; ORMVAT HQ address to confirm with the office.
